We can use the function get_shortest_driving_distance. We need to call it twice: once for NY->LA, once for LA->Miami. Then get_shortest_driving_distance({"origin":"Los Angeles","destination":"Miami","unit":"miles"}). Then get_shortest_driving_distance({"origin":"Miami","destination":"New York","unit":"miles"}). Then sum the distances.
